gate.reason: PR #602 retires the prior Content gate: CONTENT-DR30-CANONICAL-FREIGHT-002 binds the exact P2_DRESSED_REGION_A association, the deterministic FREIGHT_TRANSFER_EDGE site/ray selection, and the representative semantic connection direction. The retained admission/accommodation hook consequently has no admitted-volume lifecycle invocation after physical admission. Reusing it now would require inventing a post-admission native StructureStart generation/placement lifecycle or reopening BASE_WORLD isolation.
